options.name: allowquery
options.description: The access lists that are allowed to query this BIND zone.

options.name: allowtransfer
options.description: The access lists that are allowed to transfer this BIND zone.

options.name: allowupdate
options.description: The access lists that are allowed to submit dynamic updates for 'master' zones (e.g. dynamic DNS).

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: backupkeys
options.description: Enable backing up DNSSEC keys in the XML configuration for this BIND zone.

options.name: baseip
options.description: The IP address of the base domain for this zone. This sets an A record for the base domain.

options.name: custom
options.description: Custom BIND options for this BIND zone.

options.name: customzonerecords
options.description: Custom records for this BIND zone.

options.name: description
options.description: A description for this BIND zone.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disable this BIND zone.

options.name: dnssec
options.description: Enable DNSSEC for this BIND zone.

options.name: enable_updatepolicy
options.description: Enable a specific dynamic update policy for this BIND zone.

options.name: expire
options.description: The SOA expiry interval for this zone. TTL-style time-unit suffixes are supported (e.g. 1h, 1d, 1w), otherwise time in seconds is assumed.

options.name: forwarders
options.description: The forwarders for this BIND zone.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: mail
options.description: The SOA email address (RNAME) for this zone. This must be in an FQDN format.

options.name: minimum
options.description: The SOA minimum TTL interval (in seconds) for this zone. This is also referred to as the negative TTL. TTL-style time-unit suffixes are supported (e.g. 1h, 1d, 1w), otherwise time in seconds is assumed.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of this BIND zone.

options.name: nameserver
options.description: The SOA nameserver for this zone.

options.name: records
options.description: The records for this BIND zone.

options.name: refresh
options.description: The SOA refresh interval for this zone. TTL-style time-unit suffixes are supported (e.g. 1h, 1d, 1w), otherwise time in seconds is assumed.

options.name: regdhcpstatic
options.description: Register DHCP static mappings as records in this BIND zone.

options.name: retry
options.description: The SOA retry interval for this zone. TTL-style time-unit suffixes are supported (e.g. 1h, 1d, 1w), otherwise time in seconds is assumed.

options.name: reversev4
options.description: Enable reverse DNS for this BIND zone.

options.name: reversev6
options.description: Enable reverse IPv6 DNS for this BIND zone.

options.name: rpz
options.description: Enable this zone as part of a response policy.

options.name: serial
options.description: The SOA serial number for this zone.

options.name: slaveip
options.description: The IP address of the slave server for this BIND zone.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The default TTL interval (in seconds) for records within this BIND zone without a specific TTL.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of this BIND zone.

options.name: updatepolicy
options.description: The update policy for this BIND zone.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: view
options.description: The views this BIND zone belongs to.
